incident: FIN6 adversary emulation plan (CTID Adversary Emulation Library)

sources.title: CTID Adversary Emulation Library - FIN6 Operations Flow & Emulation Plan
sources.what_it_gave: assume-breach entry, AD discovery, NTDS/LSASS credential access, lateral movement to systems of interest (POS/server), ransomware/PoS exfil

sources.title: FireEye - Pick-Six: Intercepting a FIN6 Intrusion (2019)
sources.what_it_gave: real 2019 FIN6 ransomware intrusion the emulation is based on: lateral movement + PsExec ransomware deployment

narrative_before: This is a documented CTID emulation of FIN6 (Skeleton Spider), a financially-motivated group; the lateral-movement-to-ransomware behaviour models FIN6's real 2019 intrusions reported by FireEye (Pick-Six). The plan begins with an assume-breach foothold on a compromised host using a C2 framework (Cobalt Strike/Metasploit/more_eggs) over HTTPS. The actor enumerates the network and Active Directory with AdFind, escalates privileges via credential access, and copies/exfiltrates the Active Directory database (NTDS.dit) by SSH/FTP. Using the harvested domain credentials the actor moves laterally to systems of interest identified during discovery and deploys its operational capability - PoS malware or ransomware via PsExec/WMI - and exfiltrates data by DNS tunneling or HTTP POST.

detection_moments.description: Assume-breach foothold + discovery: C2 established, AdFind/AD enumeration from the foothold host.
detection_moments.evidence: 'assume breach using the C2 framework of your choice ... FIN6 enumerates the network and Active Directory (AD) environment' - FIN6 Operations Flow

detection_moments.description: Privilege escalation via credential access; NTDS.dit copied/exfiltrated from the domain.
detection_moments.evidence: 'escalate privileges ... made heavy use of credential access ... copying and exfiltrating the Active Directory database (NTDS.dit) file' - FIN6 Operations Flow

detection_moments.description: Lateral movement with domain credentials to systems of interest; PsExec/WMI deployment of PoS malware or ransomware.
detection_moments.evidence: 'deploys tools to systems of interest ... uses bat files for deployment, and WMI or PsExec for execution' - FIN6 Phase 2 / Operations Flow

attack_path: credential access + NTDS.dit theft to control the domain - T1003.003 / T1003.001
lateral movement to systems of interest with harvested credentials - T1021.002 / T1047
PsExec/WMI deployment of PoS malware / ransomware to target - T1047 / T1105
ambiguities: This is a documented emulation of a real campaign; the real-world basis is FIN6's 2019 ransomware intrusions (FireEye Pick-Six), hence year 2019.
The plan names hosts only by role (foothold, DC, system of interest/PoS); no specific hostnames given (plan is environment-agnostic).
Initial access is 'assume breach' in the plan, so no initial-access technique ID; foothold modelled as C2-present (risk 7).
